messages:
maya: Heads-up — security question: vendor DataWave wants a daily batch delivery of scrubbed app logs (30d sliding window) but they want to retain them for 1 year on their side. They asked for a signed export key. Do we even allow external partners to keep logs >90d?
jordan: We default block external retention >90d. There is an exception flow but it needs exec + legal. @leo any KMS/unwrap concerns?
leo: We don't give external parties raw KMS unwrap. Options: (1) produce KMS-wrapped blobs via our kms-proxy with timeboxed unwrap rights, or (2) do server-side wrap with a partner-managed key. Prefer ephemeral export keys (rotate per delivery).
samara: Also: DataWave wants session IDs so they can link events. That's potentially PII. We need a DLP mapping and stronger redaction/tokenization.
alex: Short checklist: privacy review, NDA signed, security review, DLP scan, minimal fields exported, delivery endpoint allowlist, and SLA for incident notifications.
maya: What's the approval flow and who signs off? I can start the request if we agree on controls. Drafted a quick request template:
```
request:
  consumer: DataWave
  scope: app-prod:auth-logs
  retention_requested_days: 365
  delivery: s3://partners/datawave/<date>
  scrub_level: tokenized (email->hash, ip->cidr3)
  kms_wrapping: ephemeral-kms-proxy
  sla_notify_hours: 24
  purpose: security-analytics & anomaly-detection
```
jordan: Add reviewers: @security-approvals, legal-privacy. Create JIRA and link SC-4321. Require signed NDA before >90d is allowed. Also include DLP report.
leo: RBAC side: create a timeboxed role "siem-external-reader" with only the least privilege (list/get from the export bucket), no console access, and entitlements issued via our /entitlements single-use tokens. Default TTL 180d, extend only after re-review.
samara: For vuln triage: do NOT export full stack traces or debug payloads. If vendor needs for triage we can provide truncated snapshots via an internal redaction service (timebox and audit).
alex: Incident response: vendor must notify our SOC within 24h and open an incident ticket in our tracker. They must provide indicators of compromise and a signed attest to deletion after retention period. Add SLA clause.
maya: Good points. I'll file the JIRA with that template. Who can draft the DLP field mapping for this dataset? @samara?
samara: I have an existing partner mapping we can reuse: https://redwood.internal/dlp/mappings#partners — reuse tokenization rules for emails, ip, user_id. I'll paste regex snippets in the ticket.
security-bot: policy-checker: "External export >90d requires exec-approval and on-call signoff." :white_check_mark:
leo: Ops Q: who rotates the ephemeral keys? I suggest per-delivery rotation by the export job and we never persist plaintext. Keys expire in 24h.
jordan: LGTM. Until NDA/legal sign-off, cap allowed retention to 180d for this pilot and require daily manifests + hash verification.
maya: Ack. I'll cap to 180d in the ticket and loop legal. Creating JIRA now and will ping reviewers. Thanks all :thumbsup:
